name: llamacpp-fim
description: code completion for llama.vim: llama.cpp in router mode on port 8084 over ${MAID_MODELS}/fim, serving the coder `maid models install ID --link` made current as the model "current" through /infill; one resident model, unloaded like the others when the GPU is wanted and, with autoload off, loaded only when MAID asks (maid up, maid gpu load llamacpp-fim); no chat provider (docs/models.md, Code completion)
